name: Maine
lawPassed: 2021, under An Act To Support and Improve Municipal Recycling Programs and Save Taxpayer Money (LD 1541).
status: Implementation is underway; Maine updated the law in 2025, expects producer registration/data reporting in May 2026 and first annual payments in September 2027 for 2026 packaging. Stewardship organization had not yet been selected as of late June 2026; state issued an RFP on June 15, 2026.
milestones: Producers must prepare for fees tied to the volume and type of packaging introduced into Maine, which fund municipal recycling programs.

name: Washington
lawPassed: 2025, under SB 5284 (the Recycling Reform Act, or WRAP Act).
status: Rulemaking, program design and early implementation underway.
milestones: Producer participation required through a PRO by July 1, 2026.
CAA must develop a program plan for producers by October 1, 2028.

name: California
lawPassed: 2022, under the Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act (SB 54).
status: Aggressive timeline with ongoing rulemaking implementation underway. Permanent regulations became effective May 1, 2026; enforcement and initial registration obligations began June 1, 2026.
milestones: By 2032, California requires 25% source reduction of plastic-covered material and 65% recycling of plastic-covered material.

name: Illinois
lawPassed: Not enacted. HB4064 introduced May 21, 2025; remains in proposal stage.
status: Separately, a statewide recycling needs assessment is underway; findings due December 1, 2026.
milestones: Would require producers to join a PRO with fee modulation to incentivize recyclable/reusable/post-consumer content packaging.
